relaxed.description: Calm wakefulness, eyes closed: strong 10 Hz posterior alpha, little beta.
relaxed.example_image_prompt: A luminous abstract digital painting visualising a human mind in a relaxed state: a still lake at dusk reflecting soft auroras, gentle mist drifting over water. Visual emphasis follows the measured brain rhythms: soft, flowing waves of light (75% alpha); dreamlike, surreal, hazy imagery (9% theta); crisp geometric structure and fine detail (9% beta). Colour palette: sage green and sky blue, violet and magenta, amber and warm white. Energy: very calm, almost motionless, wide open negative space. Mood: neutral, balanced lighting. No text, no letters, no logos, no anatomical brain diagrams, no people's faces.
